remaining_reading_disputes.question: In this large type, a vertical stroke seems to sit beside the tsere under the he of הֵמָּה and beside the qamats under the lamed of וְלָמָּה. Are these metegs (הֵֽמָּה, וְלָֽמָּה)? The working text has neither. I lean towards a meteg on הֵמָּה; וְלָמָּה is less clear.
There seems to be a stroke beside the hiriq under the pe. Is it a meteg (בְּפִֽינוּ)? The working text has none.

There seems to be a stroke beside the qamats under the lamed of כֻלָּנוּ and beside the tsere under the second bet of וּבִלְבָבֵנוּ. Are these metegs? The working text has none. This is a different question from the answered bet in בְּפִי and the qamats under the shin of שָׁאַתָּה (574).
There seems to be a stroke beside the tsere under the he. Is it a meteg (אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ)? The working text has none.
There seems to be a stroke beside the patah under the nun. Is it a meteg (אֲנַֽחְנוּ)? The working text has none.
There seems to be a vertical stroke near the vav's shva or under the alef. Is it a meteg (וְאֽוֹרֶךְ), or a print artifact? This is separate from the answered siglum (576).

In the small type, these words appear to have a stroke beside the segol under the tav or dalet, the same pattern as the 16 verified large-type corrections. Do they carry a meteg? The working text has none on any of them. The words are L3 תְּהִלָּתֶךָ and תִּפְאַרְתֶּךָ; L5 וְצִדְקוֹתֶיךָ, חֲסָדֶיךָ and וּגְבוּרוֹתֶיךָ; L13 דוֹרְשֶׁיךָ; L15 וּבִכְבוֹדֶךָ, וּמְשָׁרְתֶיךָ and עֲבָדֶיךָ; L19 יִחוּדֶךָ and עֵדֶיךָ; L21 יִחוּדֶךָ and וַעֲבָדֶיךָ; L27 לִסְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ and בֵּינוֹתֶיךָ.

These words appear to have meteg strokes: L7 בָּהֶם, L11 עָשָׂנוּ and אֲנַחְנוּ, L13 לָנוּ and נִמְצֵאתָ, L9 יוֹעִילוּ. Are they metegs or blur? This does not reopen 582 (no dagesh in the tsadi of צָרָה) or 580 (עָזַֽבְתָּ).
